cues: Rigid templated structure: Classification and constraints, Dependencies, Key decisions, Phase 0 first end-to-end slice, Phases, Validation checks, Cross-cutting, AI layer, Exceptions, Deferred
Explicit labels ASSUMPTION / UNKNOWN / REQUIREMENT on every budget, plus a 'Missing inputs' list instead of silently guessing
Decision table with reversibility ratings (R2/R3), default, assumption, validating check and revisit trigger
Numbered validation checks V0–V7 with hypothesis, method, acceptance threshold, evidence location and what each check unlocks, referenced from phases as exit checks
Boilerplate meta-sections such as 'N/A — no AI component', 'Exceptions: None', 'Every dependency kind has at least one instance', and a Phase 0 walking skeleton with a 'point of no return'
